description: Measures GPU cache/memory latency via single-thread cacheline-stride pointer chasing over a random Hamiltonian cycle (one node per cacheline, so every access is a fresh line). array_bytes (the working-set size) selects the targeted level: small sizes stay resident in L1/L2, mid sizes spill to MALL/Infinity Cache, large sizes to DRAM. num_accesses is derived as reuse_k * array_bytes/cacheline_bytes (K full laps, no cap): ~1 cold miss + (K-1) resident hits per line at sizes that fit a cache level, degrading to all-miss latency once the set exceeds the caches. The access count grows with array_bytes, so the largest points take minutes on hardware. No separate cache warm-up (the timed kernel self-warms; a 1-access primer only absorbs code-object load). Reports latency in nanoseconds per access.

scaling_param.name: array_bytes
scaling_param.description: Working-set size in bytes; selects which level (L1/L2/MALL/DRAM) serves the chase

non_scaling_params.name: cacheline_bytes
non_scaling_params.description: Stride between chase nodes; set to the cacheline size so each access hits a fresh line (64 B on gfx942/MI300X)

non_scaling_params.name: reuse_k
non_scaling_params.description: Laps over the working set; K=16 gives ~1 cold miss + 15 hits per line when resident
